item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-26
item.description:
Our community has seen exciting progress across multiple projects recently. In the scienceverse/metacheck project, the `data_check` branch has been the focus of attention, with new features like "reproducibility_check" and improved metadata handling through the addition of an RO-crate metadata file. Meanwhile, the marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing project has released version 0.4.1, with updates to the `gh-pages` branch and a tweak to the success alert title in `sweet_alert.js` on the `master` branch. Notably, these projects are both working towards enhancing research reproducibility and user experience, highlighting the connections between our community's efforts to improve open-source research tools. As we celebrate these milestones, we look forward to seeing how these advancements will intersect and drive further innovation in the future.

item.title: metacheck: 1 commit today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

The `data_check` branch was the focus of recent work, where a commit on July 26 added an RO-crate metadata file, replacing the existing collection.json, and also removed the full preview from the archive, while fixing regex bugs. On the same `data_check` branch, an earlier commit on July 22 added a "reproducibility_check" feature. No other branches were worked on during this period. The changes to the `data_check` branch aimed to modify the metadata handling and enhance the checking capabilities. The removal of the full preview from the archive suggests a change in how data is presented or accessed. The `data_check` branch is the only branch that received updates.

1 commit(s) today:
